newsitem.title: UK: UK Estates rejects Ashquay offer.
newsitem.headline: UK Estates rejects Ashquay offer.

text.p: British property development firm UK Estates Plc said on Thursday that it recommending shareholders not to accept an offer from Ashquay Group Plc.
UK Estates had previously been advising shareholders to take no action following the offer from the property company on November 28, but sent a defence document to shareholders today.

David Gradel, executive chairman of UK Estates said, "Ashquay's paper promises are no fair exchange for shareholders' investment in UK Estates. The board of UK Estates strongly recommends its shareholders to reject Ashquay's offers".
Ashquay, which either owns or has acceptances for 31.8 percent of UK Estates, is offering 10 shares for every 13 ordinary UK estate shares, valuing it at 21.1 million stg.
